provenance.dataset: CMS 2016 Open Data Run2016G+H NanoAODv9: Tau, SingleMuon, SingleElectron, MuonEG
provenance.version: v4 four channels, DeepTau Tight, tau_h ID SFs free per decay mode
provenance.fit_tool: TRExFitter v1.8.0, simultaneous binned profile-likelihood fit of m_tautau in 13 regions (tautau_SR0/1/2, mutau/etau_SR_dm0/1/10/11, emu_SR, emu_CRtt)
provenance.groups: Fakes = jet->tau_h / multijet (data driven); TTbar; DYtautau = Z/gamma*->tautau 60<m<120 (signal); DYtautau_out = the rest of Z/gamma*->tautau; rest = Z->ee/mumu, low-mass DY, single t, W+jets, WW/WZ/ZZ
provenance.plot_fix: yaml written 17 Sep 13:4x after cf54006 (NOSIG removed: the signal is in Total)

mutau.ff_note: inclusive over DM x N_jets x pT: (N_T - MC) / (N_L - MC) summed over the table bins (tt: simulation, no subtraction); the fit applies the binned tables
mutau.ar_fraction_note: application region (tau_h VVVLoose & !Tight, m_T < 40 GeV): multijet = data - simulation, W / tt from simulation; fractions of the jet fakes, summed over N_jets and the two m_T bins
mutau.regions_note: QCD_T/L: same-sign, isolated lepton (multijet DR); W_T/L: OS, m_T > 70 GeV, no b jet (W DR); WSS_T/L: same, same sign

etau.ff_note: inclusive over DM x N_jets x pT: (N_T - MC) / (N_L - MC) summed over the table bins (tt: simulation, no subtraction); the fit applies the binned tables
etau.ar_fraction_note: application region (tau_h VVVLoose & !Tight, m_T < 40 GeV): multijet = data - simulation, W / tt from simulation; fractions of the jet fakes, summed over N_jets and the two m_T bins
etau.regions_note: QCD_T/L: same-sign, isolated lepton (multijet DR); W_T/L: OS, m_T > 70 GeV, no b jet (W DR); WSS_T/L: same, same sign

emu.cr_definition: D_zeta < -40 GeV and p_T^miss > 80 GeV (b inclusive)
